turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! First, one example.
I work. He works.
With "he", the verb gets -s: work becomes works.
So: after he, she or it, put -s on the verb.
Right: She works at night. Wrong: She work at night.

Your turn. Write just the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
